name: AGastIa
tagline: Decodes medical reports for patients and clinicians with medical models and explanations.

awards: Best Champion of Open Source w/ Featherless - Featherless

problem: Medical reports are hard for patients to understand.
solution: OCR extracts report text; clinical language models and medical segmentation analyse it; explanations are presented for patients and clinicians.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a report and read the plain-language summary.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Champion of Open Source w/ Featherless - Featherless” among 223 submissions.

lessons: Open specialist models suit an open-source prize.
